نحتشي (form VIII)
# نَحْتَشِي (naḥtašī) /naħ.ta.ʃiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# نَحْتَشِيَ (naḥtašiya) /naħ.ta.ʃi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
